"Casino 7s" just reached Texas stores with four top prizes of $100,000. A new game is the easiest kind to judge. No prizes have been claimed, and the printed odds are accurate for now. Every day of sales changes that, and this page tracks it.

Tomorrow's count on "Casino 7s" will be a little different. The game sells every day, and this page keeps track.
2775.headline: First day on sale

2776.body:
"Patriotic Payout" has joined the Texas lineup at $2 with eight top prizes of $30,000. Only on the first day do the printed odds describe the game exactly, because nothing has been won. Starting tomorrow, this page shows how that changes.
